profile.headline: Senior Embedded Software Engineer | Internet of Things (IoT) | Robotics | Safety-Critical Systems
profile.summary:
I architect, design, write software for, and ensure the correct behaviour of Internet of Things (IoT) and Robotics solutions used in the warehouse distribution network that forms the backbone of the global retail economy.  The products I help to create provide the brawn and brains required to efficiently deliver goods to customers on time at a competitive cost.

Brawn: Our products stand up to heavy use in fast-paced, unpredictable industrial settings where downtime can be a critical handicap.  Using a variety of technologies and risk mitigation techniques — Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS), Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA), defensive programming, unit testing, fault tolerant design, and adherence to accepted industry safety standards (ISO13849, EN1175, MISRA-C), among others — I help to ensure that our Robotics solutions remain highly-reliable in order to minimize equipment downtime and maximize facility throughput for our customers.

Brains: Our products provide real-time, trustworthy, and actionable data to decision-makers tasked with leveraging their material handling fleets to achieve productivity goals.  In my career, I have worked heavily in the Signal Processing and Internet of Things (IoT) spaces, with my most recent experience being in Internet of Things (IoT).  My solutions have helped to enable automation technologies that reduce liability exposure and increase productivity for novice equipment operators, predictive maintenance technologies that can pinpoint equipment components for replacement before causing unscheduled downtime, remote fleet management technologies that allow managers to remotely change fleet performance characteristics at the press of a button, and remote fleet monitoring technologies that allow managers to collect data and understand performance trends within their fleets and operator workforce.

Beyond my current work, I have a varied background in technical sales, grant-funded machine learning research (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV), Linux, SLAM, OpenCV, Robot Operating System (ROS), C++), enterprise software development (C#, SQL), and a bit of web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, PHP).  I am also very involved in various volunteer causes, teach yoga, and am open to providing mentorship to early-career software engineers who are curious about my areas of professional specialty.

Regardless of how you found my LinkedIn profile, connect with me if you enjoy what you do.  I wish to surround myself with people who are excited about what they do and have found ways to leverage it for the good of humanity.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer, Internet of Things (IoT)
positions.description:
My team and I connect material handling systems to the Internet so that warehouse managers can more effectively see how products are moving through their facilities and correct inefficiencies.  This translates to you receiving your online purchases more quickly!

- Develop software for an embedded microcontroller (TMS320) using Code Composer Studio, C, and Unity unit-testing framework.
- Develop software for an Internet-connected Android tablet using Visual Studio Professional, C#, Xamarin, Task Parallel Library, and NUnit unit-testing framework.
- Facilitate efficient software development using the Atlassian toolsuite -- Bitbucket/Git, JIRA, Confluence, and Bamboo -- to control source code, track and report on development progress, document functionality, and automate workflows.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer, Radio Frequency Localization
positions.description:
I designed and supported material handling robot automation technologies that reduced the time it takes for customers to receive online goods.  To do this, I leveraged Radio Frequency (RF) technology and Path Planning algorithms to more efficiently navigate material handling robots through warehouses, increasing facility throughput.

In this position, I served as the primary Embedded Software Engineer for RF-based automation technologies offered by Crown.  I interfaced with multiple internal development groups to integrate my automation technologies with the products they supported.

Skills and Technologies: CANopen, CAN, Frequency-Hopping Spread Spectrum (FHSS), Radio Frequency Identification (RFID), embedded systems, Spectrum Digital XDS510 USB, automated regression testing, Git, BitBucket, JIRA, Confluence, C, and Python.

positions.title: Associate Embedded Software Engineer, Product Customization and Support
positions.description:
I designed and maintained embedded control systems for material handling robots that power the Internet storefront economy.  These robots are how we receive items that we order online.

In this position, I served as the primary Embedded Software Engineer for 11 of 14 product lines offered by Crown.  In this role, I interfaced with multiple internal development groups to integrate their technologies into Crown's products. I helped to accelerate the time-to-market of cutting edge technologies in order to lend a productivity advantage to Crown's customers.  I maintained an ambitious project completion metric of one project per week. 

I was selected in October 2017 to serve as the lead developer for a high-profile company initiative.  The project involved digital signal processing (Kalman filters, digital differentiators), real-time diagnostic monitoring, design of distributed embedded systems, systems integration, and off-target simulation using Python.  This project prepared me well for a transition to Crown's new product development group in March, 2018.

Skills and Technologies: Software development, distributed embedded systems, digital signal processing (DSP), Controller Area Network (CAN), C, Python, JIRA, Confluence, BitBucket, Git, ClearCase, and Jupyter/iPython Notebook.

projects.title: Maximized OLS Financial Backtester
projects.description:
When deciding which stock to buy and when to buy it, do you find yourself wishing you had quantitative market indicators to guide your decision?  If you do find appropriate market indicators, how do you know when they indicate something will happen with your prospective purchase?  My newly released Maximized OLS Financial Backtester helps solve this problem!

The tool maximizes a set of historical financial data in an Ordinary Least Squares model and outputs the maximized regression summary. The only thing left to do is to output the day shifts that maximize the model and add fit/significance criteria heuristics. Then we'll know which financial indicators our prospective purchases are most sensitive to and (more importantly) when the indicators provide the most predictive power.

For code and data visit my Github repository!  https://github.com/Eric-Schnipke/financial

Skills and Technologies: Machine Learning, Computational Finance, Multivariate Linear Regression, and Python.

patents.title: Method for Controlling a Functional System of a Materials Handling Vehicle
patents.description: Controlling a functional system of a materials handling vehicle includes monitoring a current delivered by an energy storage system for powering the functional system, wherein the energy storage system may include at least one of a battery and a fuel cell. When the current delivered by the energy storage system exceeds a first predetermined amount, performance of the functional system is reduced from a first operating level to a second operating level for at least one task of the functional system to attempt to reduce the current delivered by the energy storage system.
